newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 21.

text.p: - Ministry of Finance to order Wakayama-based Hanwa Bank Ltd to suspend all its business except for deposit withdrawals.
Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) plans to end special cuts in income tax and residents' tax by the end of this year amid further signs of a stronger economy.

The Ministry of Transport plans to take out one-to-three year low-interest loans from private banks to finance interest payments on debt held by the former Japan national railway group. The Ministry could take out loans of several hundred billion yen in fiscal 1996-97 to help service the debt, which currently totals more than 27 trillion yen.
